name: Can I build a detached ADU for rental purposes?

mainEntity.name: Can I build a detached ADU for rental purposes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, a detached ADU can absolutely be built for rental purposes. Many homeowners choose this option to generate additional income and help offset their mortgage or other expenses. Detached ADUs provide a self-contained living space that offers privacy for both the tenant and the primary homeowner. It's important to understand local rental ordinances and tenant laws before renting out your ADU.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, detached ADUs are commonly built for rental income, offering a private, self-contained living space for tenants.
